title: Freestanding 4-Arm Swing Towel Stand 49-Inch Solid Brass Assorted Free Standing Accessorie | Matte Gray | Allied Brass
description:
Add flexible towel storage without drilling with this freestanding 4-arm swing towel stand in Matte Gray, which provides a sophisticated neutral that complements concrete, stone, and other modern materials. Four pivoting arms provide space to hang and separate towels, helping you maximize bathroom space.

Highlights:
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Four pivoting swing arms for versatile towel storage and organization
- Solid brass construction designed to resist rust and corrosion
- Heavy solid brass base helps prevent tipping; felt pad helps prevent floor scratching
- Part of the Soho collection for coordinated transitional bathroom hardware and versatile bath accessories
